trigger: My landlord is trying to force me out
description: What to do if a landlord tries to evict you by locking you out, seizing property, or threats.

steps.text: Stay calm. A landlord cannot lawfully throw you out by force, threats, or by changing the locks.
You are entitled to due process; disputes should go through a court, not self-help (s.36(1)).
Your belongings are your property and may not simply be seized (s.44).
Ask for any notice or court order in writing. Keep a copy of your tenancy agreement and receipts.
Do not sign away your rights under pressure, and do not respond to threats with violence.
Write down what happened, dates, and any witnesses.
Contact Legal Aid or a lawyer; eviction is governed by tenancy law and often needs a court order.
